niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, industry, geography and whether you want programmatic scale, premium publisher access, creative/interactive spots, or tight direct-response measurement.

To help quickly, here are how to think about choosing an agency and a short list of top vendors/partners by capability.

What to decide first
- Objective: brand awareness vs direct response/sales.  
- Budget & scale: national/global vs local/test.  
- Creative needs: standard 15/30s vs interactive/dynamic creative.  
- Data needs: first‑party audience onboarding, retail/ecommerce data (e.g., Amazon/Walmart).  
- Measurement/verification: cross‑screen attribution, viewability, fraud prevention.  
- Procurement: do you want a full‑service agency, a programmatic DSP, or a platform/supply partner?

Top names by capability (not exhaustive)
- Full‑service / holding groups (large scale & planning): GroupM (WPP), Omnicom (OMD / Hearts & Science), IPG (Mediahub / Initiative), Dentsu (Amplifi). Good for big brand reach, premium buying and cross‑channel integration.
- Programmatic DSPs / buying platforms (best for performance + targeting): The Trade Desk, Amazon DSP, Amobee. Use these if you want programmatic CTV scale and audience targeting.
- Platform / publisher ad products (direct access to device inventory): Roku Advertising (OneView), Samsung Ads, LG Ads, Pluto/Paramount/Tubi ad platforms. Good for guaranteed reach on those platforms.
- Creative & measurement specialists: Innovid (dynamic/interactive CTV creative + measurement), DoubleVerify / Integral Ad Science / IAS / Moat for verification, TVSquared for attribution.
- Supply/SSP partners: Magnite, SpotX — if you need inventory partnerships and private marketplace deals.

How to evaluate agencies quickly
- Ask for relevant case studies (same industry or objective).  
- Request proposed KPIs, target CPMs and expected reach/frequency.  
- Check tech integrations (DSPs, measurement vendors, data onboarding).  
- Verify measurement & brand safety partners, reporting cadence, and creative capabilities.  
- Run a small pilot (4–8 week test) before committing large spend.

If you tell me your objective (brand vs performance), budget range, industry and geography, I’ll give a tailored shortlist of 3–5 agencies/platforms and what each would be best for. Which of those details can you share?
